verdict.rationale: Consensus documents natural-language querying via semantic search that captures the intent behind your question. Threads turn searches into ongoing conversations, and a research agent chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper tools on top of search. Together these show the core research workflow is driven by natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: evidence that non-search operations such as library import/management or filtering can be driven by natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
